title: Hotel Room Turnover
scenario: Calculate the number of vacant days between consecutive bookings for each room.
tableSchema: bookings (room_id INT, check_in DATE, check_out DATE)
hint: Subtract previous check_out from current check_in.
correctQuery: SELECT room_id, check_in, (check_in - LAG(check_out) OVER(PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY check_in)) AS vacant_days FROM bookings;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE bookings (room_id INT, check_in DATE, check_out DATE);
